title: Never warming up or practicing
summary: He plays cold off the street while others warm up, calling it a natural gift.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing

blocks.x: Did, uh, did you ever actually practice by yourself, get the thing and try to learn? Never warm up. Never warm up.

That's what Peewee and Davis and all them guys, they'd be down at Nick's, they'd be warming up in the back for 15 minutes. I'd walk right off the street and go one, two, right into the number and they'd say,
how does this guy do it? He's got an iron lip.
Yeah, I agree. And they'd warm up there for two, three, 15 minutes and they'd come out and they'd crack all over the place.
You never tried practicing long notes?
Never, never for tone or nothing. Nothing. Just natural. It was God gifted.
